provenance.notes: The eBird API Terms (last edited 2021-10-19) and the eBird Data Access Terms answered 403 live on 2026-11-10 and were read in Wayback snapshots (2026-08-12, 2026-05-13). API Terms: "All APIs (with few exceptions) will require a key" tied to an eBird account, not to be shared; licence for non-commercial use only, commercial purposes need prior written permission (ebird@cornell.edu); no figure, but use must not "adversely impact the stability of the ebird.org servers" (suspension); attribute "eBird.org as the source of the data ... wherever it is used or displayed", with a link back where possible; no framing or mirroring. Data Access Terms: research and education use; no passing original datasets to third parties nor publishing eBird data in their original format, whole or in part; derived data passed on only under the same terms; copies of publications sent to the Lab. The key is required for every call but the taxonomy (ref/taxonomy answered 200 without a key on 2026-11-10), so requirements.key is false; the source refuses keyed operations itself without one. Storage and caching are not stated.
